notes.title: Our new game + developer community links
notes.content:
Hello! It's been some time since we've given an update here and that's poor form on our end ːsteamsadː But we're back now! And with two bits of news.

1- If you're interesting in chatting it up with us, we've now got a Discord. We've got some new stuff cooking and we'll be sharing news, WIP art and videos, etc in our newly formed Robot Invader Discord server. We'll also be doing the occasional game giveaway and such there. If a newsletter or Twitter is more your thing, we're got those too. So if you're interesting in learning more about our previous games (we have 10!) and being the first to get info and opportunities to playtetst our next one (we're actively working on it!), plus game giveaways, we'd love for you to join our community. Here are the links:

 Robot Invader Discord server
 Robot Invader Newsletter (promise, no spam!)
 Twitter


2- our latest game SEEING THINGS recently launched! Woohoo!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12663215/e74d964983935be9cf5a6368a433a8c28792c4f1.png

It's been a lot of fun seeing players and streamers alike enjoying SEEING THINGS. It's currently sitting at 100% positive reviews. And if it sounds like it's your thing --it's got the perfect blend of silly and spooky -- we'd love for you to check it out too!

notes.title: Vive Update Live!
notes.content:
Dead Secret is now available on HTC Vive! 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12663215/024b5084528e0646324056fe06976da5f0d9d8dc.png

To celebrate the occasion, Dead Secret is 34% off--US $9.89--for two weeks. Oh yeah!

A few notes:

 for those who have already purchased Dead Secret, Vive support will arrive via an update today at no additional cost
 both the Vive Wands and gamepads are supported. To switch to the Wand, simply click the trackpad. You only need one Wand to play
 both standing and seated play are supported
 select the VR mode by launching Dead Secret while SteamVR is running, or by right-clicking and selecting "Launch Vive Version."  Your save data is shared between VR- and non-VR versions.
  Oculus Rift owners can access their free version of Dead Secret via our Oculus Key Validation Tool. 


Thank you for the support and reception to date. We're excited to hear your thoughts and feedback on solving a murder in VR. It's a grisly business, but we hope you enjoy it!
